status: Frozen corrected-accounting spatial analogue; not accepted historical geography
spatial_method: Inferred named-valley province crosswalk, checked against canonical game polygons and Willcocks Plate XII. Province shares from dated1889 seasonal basins constrain the regional distribution; within-group HYDE/LUH2 weights remain alternative related-source proxies.
uncertainty: These groups approximate historical provinces; they are not digitized basin polygons.

Known-land feasibility is not agronomic or hydraulic proof of the approximate historical footprint.
expected_effect: Test whether historically grouped basin shares reduce southern Nile over-allocation relative to one regional raster allocation; no population, consumption or development fitting
adoption_gate: Physical feasibility first, then independently assessed spatial/source uncertainty and100/200behavior; this experiment cannot by itself certify dated geography
accounting_correction: Use the same known-land recovery budget as the canonical historical model, conditional on the sourced extent. Preserve existing fields when the seasonal-basin component is smaller; retain the excess as unclassified existing cultivation, not newly identified berms. No unused recovered land becomes a game improvement opportunity.
